name: Jocaste
summary: In Darnassus, Jocaste teaches hunters who have come in from Teldrassil's wilds.

sections.title: A Mentor in the Enclave
sections.body: Jocaste trains night elf hunters in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus. Young trackers arrive after their first lessons in Shadowglen, ready to hunt in the capital. She teaches marksmanship and survival in the wild, and the bond between a hunter and the beasts of Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Jocaste trains night elf hunters in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave.
Find Jocaste in the Cenarion Enclave, in northwest Darnassus on Teldrassil's boughs.

faq.q: What role does she play for young hunters?
faq.answer: Young hunters come to Jocaste in Darnassus to advance their discipline through The Hunter's Path. She teaches them to train and master wild beasts.

faq.q: Is Jocaste affiliated with the Cenarion Circle?
faq.answer: Yes. Jocaste trains hunters in the Cenarion Enclave and welcomes visiting hunters into the presence of the Cenarion Circle.

angles.text: As a night elf hunter arriving in Darnassus, Jocaste can sharpen your combat skills and strengthen your bond with your animal companion.
As a night elf, you can see in Jocaste the harmony between your people, Teldrassil's wild beasts, and the teachings of the Cenarion Circle.
